evals.prompt: Generate unlimited creatures by randomizing limb lengths, skeleton hierarchy, bind pose, skin weights, animations, equipment sockets, and IK targets independently. We do not need seeds, provenance, extreme-case tests, or consistent identity across LODs.
evals.expected_output: A deterministic procedural-character pipeline with a versioned recipe, correlated constrained morphology, stable rig and retarget contracts, validated skinning and IK, coordinated LOD, provenance, and seed and pose sweeps.
assertions: Generation uses an explicit seed and versioned recipe with semantic parameter bounds.
Morphology, skeleton, bind pose, skinning, animation, IK, and attachments are generated or selected as a compatible system.
Bone maps, bind matrices, weights, joint limits, bounds, and retargeted contact behavior are validated.
Mesh, skeleton, materials, animation, shadows, and simulation LOD preserve character identity.
Extreme seeds, pose ranges, transitions, equipment, cloning, disposal, performance, and source provenance are tested.
